Name: GESTURE_PARAM_ST
Description: Gestures. The row ID is the gesture ID used by events, CharaInitParam and the gesture menu. Unlocking a gesture also gives its goods item when the player doesn't have it.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).

Fields.Name: Goods ID
Fields.Description: EquipParamGoods row of the gesture. The gesture menu takes the name and icon from this goods row, and unlocking the gesture adds this goods item if the player doesn't own it. Retail: 9000+ (base game), 2009000+ (DLC).

Fields.Name: Message Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation played by the phantom of a player message left with this gesture attached. Retail: 80000 + 10 × gesture ID for most rows.

Fields.Name: Cannot Use while Riding
Fields.Description: The gesture can't be used while riding Torrent. Retail: set on every row.
